description: You can compare applying a function to list elements with passing a list as its arguments.

steps.description: map subtracts matching elements of L2 from L1. L3 holds three copies of -3.

steps.answer: It receives -3, -3, and -3 as arguments, giving -9.
steps.question: What does apply + receive from L3?

steps.description: apply passes the list elements to + in one call.
The lambda squares its argument. A direct call gives 25, while map produces the list (1 4 9 16 25).

title: Map elements and apply arguments
